resolved_bugs.report: Delete custom on device A; device B (which had pulled it earlier) still shows it after re-pulling from Drive.
resolved_bugs.how: Root cause was handleCustomWorkoutsResponse doing a union/merge (added drive customs, never removed absent ones). Changed to a MIRROR: before merging, any local custom id not in the drive array is deleted from workout_split_plan + customworkout_<id> + customworkout_indices. Guard: if the read returns an object ({status:…} or {workout_logs:…}) instead of an array, bail early with a warning so a failed/unauthorized pull can't wipe local customs.
resolved_bugs.test: pull_mirror_test.mjs in opencode scratch dir (all pass: empty-drive drops stale local; union merges updates; unauthorized + wrong-file preserve local).

resolved_bugs.how: deleteCustomWorkout now does a silent push + a 2s-delayed verifyDriveFile('custom_workouts') GET that toasts one of 4 states (✅ removed / ❌ unauthorized → ?key=MYJEY / ❌ old-script-ignores-target / ⚠️ still-on-Drive) and logs the raw Drive array to console. This surfaces the previously-silent fire-and-forget failure modes.
resolved_bugs.note: Root cause was a silent push (no feedback) — the code path was already correct as long as the saved /exec URL carried ?key=MYJEY. The verify makes that requirement visible instead of a silent no-op. Test: delete_verify_test.mjs in opencode scratch dir (ok / unauthorized / still-there all pass).

key_mechanics.single_active_day_lock: active_timer_<dayId> in localStorage gates editing; getActiveRunningDay() walks split plan.
key_mechanics.day_id_parsing: resolveDayId(id) matches real split_plan keys (handles custom ids with underscores). Do NOT reintroduce /(day[0-9]+)/.
key_mechanics.custom_flag: day.custom === true distinguishes custom plans (rendered with a delete button) from static Day 1-4.
key_mechanics.hydration: today's log -> white (user-edited); non-today log -> gray via setGrayValue().
key_mechanics.autosave: triggerAutoSave -> 600ms debounce -> saveSession; only fires when workout active; local save independent from cloud.

gotchas_learnt: Apps Script changes require REDeploy (Manage deployments -> New version) to the same /exec URL; save alone is not enough.
Hidden-iframe form POST is fire-and-forget: client cannot see success/failure. 'Verify On Drive' does a follow-up GET to detect problems.

302 redirect (to Google sign-in) with a large HTML body in DevTools = the /exec URL is hitting an auth wall (wrong key value in URL, or deployment access/scope not granted to Anyone). Both pull and push silently fail in that state while local save still works.
jsdom is installed at /var/folders/t_/dkx509097s3dbl3xhpfmdq980000gn/T/opencode (node_modules) — use it for headless DOM tests; force process.exit() since the app's setInterval keeps the loop alive.
